summary: Runner processes deregistered mid-job during credential-rotation window; jobs aborted without SIGTERM logs
description:
Issue summary: Several self-hosted CI runners in the us-west production pool deregistered from the coordinator while active jobs were running. Impact: multiple release pipeline jobs were abruptly aborted, causing blocked canaries and a partial release rollback. This occurred during a scheduled credentials rotation performed by the secrets-service (v2 rollout).

Observed behavior: Jobs fail with 'runner lost connection' in pipeline UI, pod in k8s reports normal termination with no SIGTERM/SIGKILL in kubelet logs, and no runner-side stack traces. Coordinator shows runner last-seen TTL expired during rotation window.

Expected behavior: Secret rotation should update credentials without causing active runner deregistration or orphaned jobs. Runners should gracefully drain or receive proper shutdown signals and re-register with new credentials without aborting running jobs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In prod us-west, schedule a rolling secret rotation of the CI signing key in secrets-service v2 (non-disruptive mode).
2) Trigger a long-running release pipeline job (integration tests + canary deploy steps) that keeps runner occupied for ~20 minutes.
3) Observe runner coordinator and k8s pod lifecycle while rotation is applied to runner role/service account.
4) Note: in our repro we saw deregistration after the secret swap on node 7 and job aborted immediately in pipeline UI.
5) Collect runner logs, coordinator audit events, and kubelet events around the timeframe (timestamps below).
logs: 2026-03-12T03:11:07Z coordinator: runner-register request from runner-id r-7f3a escaped TTL check, issued session token old-cred
2026-03-12T03:11:12Z secrets-service: rotated key for role ci-runner/us-west; version bumped v3 -> v4 (fingerprint a1b2) [deploy-id: rot-20260312-1]
2026-03-12T03:11:19Z k8s node node-07 kubelet: Container runtime reported exit of process (exit code 0) for pod ci-runner-r7f3a but no TERM/KILL recorded
2026-03-12T03:11:20Z coordinator: runner r-7f3a heartbeat missed; marking offline; active job j-991 aborted (reason: runner unavailable)
2026-03-12T03:11:21Z pipeline: job j-991 transition ERROR (aborted by system): no runner available
2026-03-12T03:12:00Z secrets-service: rotation completed, new credentials available; several runners re-registered successfully post-rotation
investigation_notes:
Timeline reconstructed from coordinator audit and k8s events. Hypothesis: the credentials rotation changed the identity assertion path (token audience/issuer) and triggered the runner health-check to fail TTL validation; the runner process then performed an uncontrolled exit (exit code 0) rather than performing graceful shutdown. We could not find SIGTERM in kubelet logs, suggesting the runner process crashed or did a self-exit.

Checked codepaths: runner auth refresh module and the secrets-service client. The new secrets-service agent introduces a short-lived transitional token (5s overlap) and a token handshake that validates issuer claims; if validation fails, the agent calls os.Exit(0) to force restart — this pattern appears in the new client library introduced by PR github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/389.

Repro notes: reproduced in staging with the same rotation agent (staging us-west). When we forced the agent to return auth failure instead of os.Exit, runner remained registered and retried with backoff as expected.

Impact scope: approx 8 runners in the prod pool showed same pattern during the window; roughly 12 release jobs aborted across teams. No customer-facing API impact observed.

Next steps: 1) Roll back secrets-service agent to previous behavior (avoid os.Exit on transient validation error) OR implement graceful drain + retry in runner-side auth refresh. 2) Add telemetry to detect ungraceful runner exits with cause and correlate with rotation windows. 3) Publish a short runbook for on-call to pin runner credential version during scheduled rotations.

resolution: Partial mitigation in place: rotation for ci-runner role paused; infra patch (PR 395) removed os.Exit call and implements retry/backoff on transient auth validation failures. Staging validation passed (3 stress runs). Prod hotfix scheduled 2026-03-14 18:00 UTC. Follow-ups: add exit-reason telemetry, update runbook, and add canary to future secrets-service releases to exercise long-running runner behavior.
follow_up_actions: 1) Deploy PR 395 to prod as hotfix and monitor runner registration for 2h after deployment
2) Add logging of runner exit reasons and coordinator last-exit-code (ticket INT-30543 to track),
3) Update secrets-service rollout checklist to include a pinned-runner window and preflight test job
4) Create synthetic test that runs long jobs during rotation to catch regressions
5) Postmortem write-up and notify release engineering teams
